/* saveMyPage - Lee JiSeob */
MERGE INTO SAB210 /* 마이페이지 */ USING DUAL ON (USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO})
WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE
DELETE WHERE (USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO})
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT ( USER_ID, MENU_NO, MENU_NM, SRTNG_SQNCE, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{USER_ID}, #{MENU_NO}, (SELECT D.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_NO = #{MENU_NO}), ( SELECT CASE COUNT(*) WHEN 0 THEN 3 ELSE MAX(SRTNG_SQNCE) + 1 END FROM SAB210 /* 마이페이지 */ WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID} ), #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
/* selectMyPage - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
"LEVEL", MENU_NO, MENU_NM, URL_ADDR, PROGRM_NM, UP_MENU_ID, UP_MENU_NM, MENU_LEVELA_NO, MENU_RM_CN, PROGRAM_RM_CN, PROGRM_ID, PARA_CN, TOP_MENU_ID, TOP_MENU_NM, TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, TWO_DEPTH_MENU_NM, SRTNG_SQNCE
FROM (
SELECT
1 AS "LEVEL", 1 AS MENU_NO, '마이페이지' AS MENU_NM, '' AS URL_ADDR, '' AS PROGRM_NM, 0 AS UP_MENU_ID, '' AS UP_MENU_NM, 1 AS MENU_LEVELA_NO, '' AS MENU_RM_CN, '' AS PROGRAM_RM_CN, '' AS PROGRM_ID, '' AS PARA_CN, 1 AS TOP_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS TOP_MENU_NM, 0 AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, '' AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_NM, 1 AS SRTNG_SQNCE
FROM DUAL
UNION ALL
SELECT
2 AS "LEVEL", 2 AS MENU_NO, '마이페이지' AS MENU_NM, '' AS URL_ADDR, '' AS PROGRM_NM, 1 AS UP_MENU_ID, '' AS UP_MENU_NM, 2 AS MENU_LEVELA_NO, '' AS MENU_RM_CN, '' AS PROGRAM_RM_CN, '' AS PROGRM_ID, '' AS PARA_CN, 1 AS TOP_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS TOP_MENU_NM, 2 AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_NM, 2 AS SRTNG_SQNCE
FROM DUAL
UNION ALL
SELECT
3 AS "LEVEL", 1150 AS MENU_NO, '내 정보 수정' AS MENU_NM, D.URL_ADDR, D.PROGRM_NM,
2 AS UP_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS UP_MENU_NM,
3 AS MENU_LEVELA_NO, E.RM_CN AS MENU_RM_CN, D.RM_CN AS PROGRAM_RM_CN, D.PROGRM_ID, E.PARA_CN,
1 AS TOP_MENU_ID,
'마이페이지' AS TOP_MENU_NM, 2 AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_NM, 3 AS SRTNG_SQNCE
FROM SAB200 E /* 메뉴 */ JOIN SAB100 D /* 프로그램 */ ON D.PROGRM_ID = E.PROGRM_ID
WHERE E.MENU_NO = 1150
UNION ALL
SELECT
3 AS "LEVEL", 4803 AS MENU_NO, '업무및메뉴권한신청' AS MENU_NM, D.URL_ADDR, D.PROGRM_NM,
2 AS UP_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS UP_MENU_NM,
3 AS MENU_LEVELA_NO, E.RM_CN AS MENU_RM_CN, D.RM_CN AS PROGRAM_RM_CN, D.PROGRM_ID, E.PARA_CN,
1 AS TOP_MENU_ID,
'마이페이지' AS TOP_MENU_NM, 2 AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_NM, 4 AS SRTNG_SQNCE
FROM SAB200 E /* 메뉴 */ JOIN SAB100 D /* 프로그램 */ ON D.PROGRM_ID = E.PROGRM_ID
WHERE E.MENU_NO = 4803
UNION ALL
SELECT
3 AS "LEVEL", C.MENU_NO, C.MENU_NM, D.URL_ADDR, D.PROGRM_NM, 2 AS UP_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS UP_MENU_NM, 3 AS MENU_LEVELA_NO, E.RM_CN AS MENU_RM_CN, D.RM_CN AS PROGRAM_RM_CN, D.PROGRM_ID, E.PARA_CN,
/* ( SELECT F.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 F WHERE F.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH F.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR F.UP_MENU_NO = F.MENU_NO ) AS TOP_MENU_ID, */
1 AS TOP_MENU_ID,
'마이페이지' AS TOP_MENU_NM, 2 AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_NM, C.SRTNG_SQNCE + 2 AS SRTNG_SQNCE
FROM SAB210 C /* 마이페이지 */ JOIN SAB200 E /* 메뉴 */ ON E.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO JOIN SAB100 D /* 프로그램 */ ON D.PROGRM_ID = E.PROGRM_ID
WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID}
/* ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE, MENU_NM */
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS "LEVEL", 5199 AS MENU_NO, '기관 관리' AS MENU_NM, D.URL_ADDR, D.PROGRM_NM, 2 AS UP_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS UP_MENU_NM, 3 AS MENU_LEVELA_NO, E.RM_CN AS MENU_RM_CN, D.RM_CN AS PROGRAM_RM_CN, D.PROGRM_ID, (SELECT TO_CHAR(INST_NO) FROM SAB230 WHERE MAIST_YN = 'Y' AND (SUBSTR(GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD, 2, 2) = '10' OR SUBSTR(GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD, 2, 2) = '20' OR GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD = '100' OR GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD = '200') AND USER_ID = #{USER_ID}) AS PARA_CN, 1 AS TOP_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS TOP_MENU_NM, 2 AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_ID, '마이페이지' AS TWO_DEPTH_MENU_NM, 4 AS SRTNG_SQNCE FROM SAB200 E /* 메뉴 */ JOIN SAB100 D /* 프로그램 */ ON D.PROGRM_ID = E.PROGRM_ID WHERE E.MENU_NO = 5199 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAB230 WHERE MAIST_YN = 'Y' AND USER_ID = #{USER_ID} /* 권한 확인 */ AND (SUBSTR(GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD, 2, 2) = '10' OR SUBSTR(GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD, 2, 2) = '20' OR GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD = '100' OR GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD = '200'))
) C
ORDER BY C.SRTNG_SQNCE
